conditions.isolation: Fresh Godot user profile and process for every invasion; camera runs fresh except explicit prepared-cache seeding; sequential owned GPU workloads. Profile isolation alone did not prevent the quarantined v2 VSync restoration bug.
conditions.host: Shared host; external activity not continuously monitored. OS filesystem and shared driver caches retained and warmed by preceding work.
conditions.camera: Initial entry cameras: one equipped local actor at entry anchors; distance14m, pitch-60; three360-frame rotations after30s settlement, rotation cap60 and VSync off. Load-only ABBA skips rotation settlement. Separate private arena cameras use26m/FOV50 at Resin wave centre196,87, preserving the complete warming and rotation workload.
conditions.warmup: Arrival camera shader warmup preserved:240 views, two actual draws/view, pitches-60/-15,3degree yaw steps, small aspect-preserving viewport, full mesh LOD, uncapped only during warming; requested cap restored.
conditions.invasions: Production creature profiles and current Main DTO bridge; synthetic seeded footprint-aware placement and scripted movement/melee packets, not server AI, navigation, online combat or network qualification.
conditions.publication_caps: 500 remote creatures is above default actor160/creature200 publication caps;300 is also a stress population. Body cap60 is a soft residency distance budget, not a guarantee of60 built or visible models.
conditions.memory_scope: Godot static allocator and RenderingServer texture/buffer/video counters are snapshots, not RSS or measured physical VRAM residency. External Linux VmRSS/VmHWM observations cover owned engine lifetime including loading/teardown, not sample-only peaks;1Hz can miss transient RSS peaks and reports HWM only through last observation.
conditions.timing_scope: Delivered FPS uses1000/mean wall interval. Frame-work excludes frame-cap sleep. CPU phases and GPU monitors overlap and nested timers must not be summed; GPU monitors describe the most recently completed viewport.
conditions.census_scope: Built-only tiers and built bodies in frustum are reported separately from actor records. visibleBuiltBodies means range/tree eligible, not occlusion- or pixel-visible. skeletonsProcessing means subtree enabled, not updates on each sampled frame.
conditions.strict_v4_scope: Each cell must attest VSync OFF and requested cap before and after sampling, no pending/visible arrival or head warmup, and complete240-view two-draw camera warming. Gauntlet observer is separate from published wave centre; v4 requires at least8 built bodies in frustum. Render-scale .50 versus .75 is an isolated diagnostic profile change, not a new default recommendation.
conditions.phase_values_scope: WorldLoader phase dictionaries retain their native names: most durations are microseconds, but image/thread/shape keys are counts and nested phases overlap.

validation_checks.scope: Completed checks supplied by the coordinator; the evidence builder did not run further engine or test workloads.

post_merge.scope: Combined benchmark, packaging, storage and publication regression suite after merging the later release-storage changes; no additional rendered performance measurements.

excluded_trials.reason: Offline fixture did not seed AppState actor_footprints, so Main overwrote lich2x2 footprints with1x1. All160/300/500 cells excluded. Repeated synthetic damage also lacked a bounded reset; corrected fixture validates live health and real Main footprint/scale bridge. No timing from this session is accepted.

JSON numeric actor type624.0 was converted to a string instead of integer624 before profile lookup. Creature-profile validation rejected the fixture before sampling; corrected integer-key lookup is required.

Temporary storage quota raised OSError122 before the first usable v4 result. The incomplete attempt was retained separately; completed older configuration artifacts were archived to ignored workspace storage before fresh retries. No timing from this attempt is accepted.
Sandboxed child could not connect to X11/Wayland and exited1 before rendering. No usable timing or screenshot; retries use authorized desktop access outside the sandbox wrapper.

limitations: Local K620 screening with synthetic client presentation; no fresh exported-release qualification.
Entry anchors and fixed invasion camera do not qualify complete gauntlet traversal, boss fights, AI, navigation, server scaling or online latency.
Initial camera entry pairs have one run per condition; Harrow ABBA has two per mode. Performance claims require matched repeat evidence.
Assets/source identities in invasion manifests are exact for their declared closure; import-cache bytes are not included.
No automatic promotion of experimental cache modes or changes to default shader warming follow from these trials.

invasion_render_scale.qualification: One controlled process pair, not repeated causal or population-invariant performance proof.
invasion_render_scale.interpretation: Scale .50 lowered GPU time with the same78 built/frustum bodies, but wall p95 remained about26ms and average FPS stayed near the60 cap. This does not establish a general pacing fix or a new default.

invasion_minimap_visibility.qualification: One controlled process pair, not repeated causal or population-invariant performance proof.
invasion_minimap_visibility.interpretation: Hiding the minimap removed most measured map-update CPU work and reduced this pair's pacing tail. Built/frustum bodies differ78 versus77, and only one pair was observed: do not attribute the full FPS/tail difference solely to the minimap or recommend hiding it by default.

source_observations_not_performance_tria.raw_world_lods: The raw WorldLoader import/batching path has no generated-LOD pass; no geometry-LOD configuration was benchmarked here.
source_observations_not_performance_tria.scope: Read-only source observations. Batch-cell size and new LOD processing were not trialled and are not recommended default changes. Only explicitly recorded render-scale, cap and minimap configurations were controlled.
